subject: Entropy Health: proposal for security pack structuring and risk-share
messages:
From: Priya Varma <priya@entropyhealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@entropyhealth.com>, procure@entropyhealth.com
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Security pack ask + pricing orientation

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the demo last week — team was impressed by the observability and the ability to pin model versions. Procurement asked me to surface two things so we can align on commercials before the next legal review: 

1) How do you typically structure the evidence/audit-log add-on for pilots vs production? Do we get a trial tier for exportable audit logs?
2) KMS/HSM seat vs throughput billing — we run a mix of EHR calls and background analytics; need a suggested cost split for pilot (3 months) then scale.

Attached is our current SOW outline (Entropy_SOW_v1.pdf) and a small spreadsheet outlining our expected audit-log volume (AuditLog_Tiering.xlsx).

Goal: land on a pricing pathway that lets us run a realistic pilot without lingering procurement blockers. Can your team propose a 2-option structure we can present to Legal?

Appreciate it — Priya

--
Priya Varma
Head of Platform Partnerships
Entropy Health
attachments: Entropy_SOW_v1.pdf (pdf, 320KB), AuditLog_Tiering.xlsx (xlsx, 24KB)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Priya Varma <priya@entropyhealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security pack ask + pricing orientation

Priya — thanks for sending this over and for the clear ask. Quick answers up front, then a proposed two-option structure.

Short answers:
- Pilot audit logs: we offer a pilot evidence tier at no additional recurring fee for up to 90 days (limited retention and export SLA). For production we map retention tiers to a per-GB/month fee.
- KMS/HSM: two common patterns: (A) pass-through HSM seats with a small monthly seat fee plus per-request throughput charge, or (B) blended throughput-based surcharge with no per-seat.

Proposed two-option commercial pathway (concise):
Option A — Pilot-first, conservative conversion
- 90-day pilot: Audit-log pilot included (30 days retention, exportable CSV once at end)
- HSM for pilot: 1 seat funded by Redwood for pilot (no seat fee), throughput billed at reduced pilot rate (50% of published surcharge)
- Conversion: if Entropy converts within 60 days of pilot end, pilot paid credits convert to a one-time onboarding credit toward first-year compliance fees (max $12k)

Option B — Fast-track production (preferred for customers needing immediate SLA)
- Pilot: 30-day PoC with full audit retention (90 days) for an interim monthly fee (covers evidence ingestion costs)
- HSM: customer-funded seats; Redwood provides discounted seats for year-1 at 40% off list with annual commit
- Audit-log production: tiered per-GB pricing with a discount ladder tied to yearly commit (3 tiers)

Next steps we propose: internal pricing alignment on which pilot concessions map to credit amounts, and whether Entropy wants seat-funded or throughput-blend at scale. If you’re okay I’ll loop in our Pricing lead (Ben) and Commercial Ops (Aditya) to give concrete numbers.

Would 9/12 at 10am PT for a quick commercial alignment call work?

Thanks,
Naomi

--
Naomi Feldman
Sr. Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Priya Varma <priya@entropyhealth.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security pack ask + pricing orientation

Priya / Naomi — following Naomi’s note, our commercial team sketched two concrete numeric pathways to make it easier for Entropy / Procurement to review. High level numbers below (all USD). These are indicative — final terms subject to commitment and SOW.

Option A (Pilot-first conversion credit model)
- Pilot (90 days): Audit-log pilot included free (export at end), Redwood funds 1 HSM seat for pilot (operational cost ~$2,500/mo)
- Pilot throughput surcharge: $0.015 per 1k requests (pilot rate; ~50% of published)
- Conversion credit: if converted within 60 days, Redwood issues a one-time credit equal to 50% of pilot surcharges to apply against year-1 compliance fees (capped at $12,000)

Option B (Expedited production)
- Pilot (30 days, production-retention): $2,400/mo (covers audit ingestion and 90-day retention)
- HSM seats: list $2,500/seat/mo; year-1 discounted to $1,500/seat/mo with a 12-month commit
- Audit-log production: $0.15/GB/mo at Tier 1 (0-1TB), $0.10/GB/mo Tier 2 (1-10TB), custom pricing above 10TB
- Throughput-blend alternative: surcharge $0.02 per 1k requests with 10% commit discount on annualized spend

Attachments: I pushed a short worksheet to the Entropy Drive link you provided to show how these numbers map to your AuditLog_Tiering.xlsx assumptions.

Open items before we lock numbers:
- Legal: data residency clause clarity (do they require EU-only storage?)
- Security team: do they need HSM attestation or on-prem HSM? That affects seat economics.
- Procurement: preferred billing cadence (quarterly vs annual) — credits are easier with annual invoices.

We can convert these into redlines for an SOW/Term sheet if Entropy indicates a preferred option. Naomi — I can join the call 9/12 10am PT and walk procurement through line items.

Thanks,
Aditya

--
Aditya Rao
Head of Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Varma <priya@entropyhealth.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security pack ask + pricing orientation

Priya — quick note from leadership: we like Option A as it reduces procurement friction and demonstrates value. A couple of guardrails if Entropy accepts Option A:

1) Pilot data retention: pilot export is one-time CSV export at end of pilot; post-conversion we migrate retention to agreed tiering.
2) HSM seat funding: Redwood funds one HSM seat for pilot only; any additional seats must be customer-funded.
3) Conversion window: pilot must convert within 60 days of pilot end to receive the credit.

If Entropy is comfortable with those guardrails Naomi, please confirm and we’ll prepare a short SOW addendum and a credit memo for procurement. Also set billing cadence to annual invoicing to simplify credit application.

Naomi — please share the SOW addendum draft and Ben/Aditya will finalize numeric fields. Priya / Jordan — send over your procurement contact if different from procure@entropyhealth.com and we’ll get a DocuSign-ready term sheet out by EOD 9/15.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
VP, Commercial
Redwood Inference
